notes: First release with a release number in the teacher view, and this Update page.
Move columns freely: the Students, Bell Schedule, Schedule Calendar and Destinations tabs now find each column by its heading, so you can put the columns in any order (keep the heading names).
To-do due dates: give a reminder a date and a Later item moves to Now on that day (due today / overdue shown).
Photos on class memories: add or paste a picture; it shows in the teacher view and on the year-end page (kept privately in your Google Drive).
One color choice for every page, and a corner bar with Colors and Pop out on the classroom tools.
Scoreboard halves, new dice shapes and a name picker fix.
Your copy lets Colleen know it's in use (your email, Sheet name and release number), so she can tell you about updates.
Corrected the Student Photos help text in Settings.
